description.text:
Victory Star Guide (胜象星引) was the sixth enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 15 November 2024 in six-card packs with two holos, 20 packs to a box. Unown is on its cover: Unown V's attack Victory Symbol wins the game when its player has one Prize card left, and Unown VSTAR's VSTAR Power attack, Star Cipher, makes all the opponent's Pokémon weak to Psychic for as long as it stays in play.

It brought more Lost Zone cards for the decks Shadow of the Blue Sea started, among them Sableye, whose attack places 12 damage counters once ten cards are in the Lost Zone, Delphox V, and Rotom V and VSTAR; the Radiant Pokémon Greninja and Charjabug; Regidrago V and VSTAR, whose attack can use an attack of any Dragon Pokémon in the discard pile; Alolan Vulpix VSTAR; Hatterene VMAX; the Supporter Lance; and Forest Seal Stone, a Tool that gives a Pokémon V a VSTAR Power to take any card from the deck. Its main cards are numbered out of 72; full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards run to 96.
